title: Drupal Core — Threat Intelligence Update
headline: Both Drupal core installer flaws are now confirmed exploited and on CISA KEV: CVE-2026-132165 (unauthenticated takeover and remote code execution via core/install.php; KEV due 2026-11-27) and the follow-on access bypass CVE-2026-136716 (KEV added 2026-11-27, due 2026-11-30). Upgrade to 10.6.23, 11.3.23 or 11.4.14, which fix both.
summary: AEGIS records CVE-2026-132165 (SA-CORE-2026-017) as listed in CISA KEV on 2026-11-24 (due 2026-11-27). Drupal rates it Highly critical (20/25) and states it received a report of exploitation on live sites as early as 2026-11-19 19:00 UTC. Fixes shipped on 2026-11-18 in 10.6.22, 11.3.22 and 11.4.13. University of Toronto InfoSec reports that core/install.php ships on every site and is not blocked by the default .htaccess, so most sites expose it unless locked down. A follow-on flaw, CVE-2026-136716 (SA-CORE-2026-019, access bypass in the installer, Highly critical 21/25), affects versions before 10.6.23, 11.3.23 and 11.4.14; Drupal states “This is being exploited in the wild”, and CISA added it to KEV on 2026-11-27. AEGIS tracks 7 public GitHub repositories for CVE-2026-132165 (unvetted).
changes: 2026-11-18: Drupal released SA-CORE-2026-017 (CVE-2026-132165) with fixes in 10.6.22, 11.3.22 and 11.4.13 (Drupal advisory, reported by University of Toronto InfoSec).
2026-11-24: CISA added CVE-2026-132165 to KEV with a due date of 2026-11-27 (AEGIS KEV record, catalog version 2026.11.25). ENISA EUVD also marks it exploited (AEGIS).

2026-11-25/26: CVE-2026-136716 (SA-CORE-2026-019), a follow-on installer access bypass, was published. Fixed versions are 10.6.23, 11.3.23 and 11.4.14 (AEGIS CVE record; NCSC-NL, CERT-FR and CERT-Bund advisories).
2026-11-20 to 2026-11-27: the number of public PoC and scanner repositories grew to 6 (AEGIS PoC tracking).
2026-11-27: AEGIS raised a high alert for the new critical CVE in this category (alert 9bfffb594981).
2026-11-27: CISA added CVE-2026-136716 to KEV with a due date of 2026-11-30 (AEGIS KEV record). NVD published a CVSS 3.1 score of 9.8 for CVE-2026-132165 (AEGIS record, NVD analyzed 2026-11-27).
assessment: CVE-2026-132165. NVD CVSS 3.1: 9.8 (analyzed 2026-11-27; no NVD score existed when this briefing was first written). Drupal rates it Highly critical, 20/25. CWE-306, missing authentication for a critical function. CVE-2026-136716: CVSS 9.8 (CNA); Drupal Highly critical, 21/25.

Network, via core/install.php. No authentication is required. Drupal describes the access as complex and the target as an uncommon configuration. Some paths are blocked if the web server cannot write to settings.php (University of Toronto, Cyber Kendra).
Site takeover by re-running the installer, then remote code execution on the host (University of Toronto, Cyber Kendra).

Confirmed. CVE-2026-132165: CISA KEV 2026-11-24, ENISA EUVD, and Drupal's own report of exploitation on live sites from 2026-11-19 19:00 UTC. CVE-2026-136716: Drupal states it is being exploited in the wild; CISA KEV 2026-11-27. Scale, actors and targets are not published.
No named victims were found. Secondary reporting describes hijacked unpatched sites, but this was not verified at a primary source.
Yes. AEGIS tracks 7 public GitHub repositories for CVE-2026-132165 and 1 for CVE-2026-136716, including exploit and scanner code, all unvetted.
CISA KEV: CVE-2026-132165 added 2026-11-24, due 2026-11-27; CVE-2026-136716 added 2026-11-27, due 2026-11-30. Known ransomware use: unknown. VulnCheck KEV: not recorded in AEGIS.
AEGIS EPSS (2026-11-26): 0.11053, 96.6th percentile. For CVE-2026-136716: 0.01014, 62.3rd percentile.
Patches are available. Upgrade to 10.6.23, 11.3.23 or 11.4.14, which address both CVEs. Branches that are end of life (10.5.x and below, 11.2.x and below, 8, 9) get no fix. Priority: immediate.
affected: Unauthenticated site takeover and code execution on public websites and portals
Installer access bypass on sites patched only for CVE-2026-132165 or left in incomplete install states
End-of-life Drupal branches (8, 9, 10.5.x and below, 11.2.x and below)
No vendor fix. Exposure persists until the site is migrated or install.php is blocked
actions: Inventory all Drupal sites, including staging and forgotten microsites. Block /core/install.php at the web server or WAF and confirm it returns 403.
Immediately (today; KEV due date 2026-11-27 for US federal agencies)
Upgrade Drupal core to 10.6.23, 11.3.23 or 11.4.14 and run database updates.

Hunt for compromise: POST requests to /core/install.php after go-live, changes to settings.php or the user 1 account, new administrators, unexpected .php files under sites/default/files, and web processes spawning shells.
Make settings.php and sites/default non-writable by the web server, and update PHP.
Plan migration of end-of-life Drupal branches.
The CISA KEV due date binds US federal agencies. The other targets are AEGIS recommendations, not mandatory CISA deadlines.
monitoring: SA-CORE-2026-017 is followed by SA-CORE-2026-019 (CVE-2026-136716). Watch for further revisions.
CVE-2026-136716 (follow-on); CVE-2026-132166 (SA-CORE-2026-018, a gadget chain fixed in the same releases)
NVD scored CVE-2026-132165 at 9.8 on 2026-11-27; CVE-2026-136716 carries a CNA score of 9.8.
Confirmed for both: CVE-2026-132165 (KEV, EUVD, Drupal report) and CVE-2026-136716 (Drupal SA-CORE-2026-019, KEV).
Drupal publishes core security releases on Wednesdays as needed.
limitations: When first written on 27 Nov, the drupal.org advisories could not be fetched; they were read and verified on 28 Nov. The ENISA EUVD record was not fetched. No IOCs, actor attribution or victim counts were found.
judgment: Confirmed: both Drupal installer flaws are exploited in the wild and on CISA KEV, and neither needs authentication. Drupal is widely deployed, so this is an emergency for any organization running Drupal. Treat every unpatched or unblocked install.php as potentially compromised and hunt before closing. Upgrading to 10.6.23, 11.3.23 or 11.4.14 closes both CVEs.

corrections.text: This briefing was corrected. As first published it said Drupal rated CVE-2026-132165 “Critical” and attributed the 20/25 score to an AI-written source; Drupal’s own advisory rates it Highly critical, 20/25. It also called exploitation of CVE-2026-136716 “reported but unverified”, although Drupal had stated on 2026-11-25 that it is being exploited in the wild; CISA has since added it to KEV. The NVD score (9.8), PoC count and KEV status were updated to current values.
